title: City: maps & the real world
body: The big scale. I love playing with real-world data like maps, point clouds and GPS, and turning it into something you can actually move through, be it a digital twin or location-based AR. The fact that this is possible is still magical to me.

title: Room: games, apps & toys
body: The human scale, the things people pick up and play with. Games, apps, websites, buttons and sliders. This is where I get to prototype fast, from a tiny mobile game or a training sim to a whole UX overhaul. If it makes someone smile or learn something, I did my job.

title: Chip: tools & the nerdy bits
body: The smallest scale is the one that makes my work easier: tools, computer vision, AI and the work nobody sees. From SDKs, synthetic data and NPCs you can talk to, to a simple but solid backend. The stuff needed to run everything.
